# Daniel Hipskind

> Daniel Hipskind is a software engineer and the founder of Greigh Studios LLC,
> an independent software studio. This site is his personal portfolio covering
> his projects, skills, and background.

## About

- Software engineer — React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Flutter/Dart, Swift, Kotlin
- Founder of Greigh Studios LLC, an independent software studio
- Creator of Sensecast, a weather app for iOS, iPadOS, and Android
- Studied computer programming at Grand Rapids Community College

## Projects

- [Sensecast](https://sensecast.app): Weather app that routes each forecast to the
  agency that actually models your terrain across 18 sources, explains every
  metric in plain language, and runs live tornado, power-grid, and storm
  trackers underneath the forecast. On the App Store and Google Play.
- [Adamas](https://danielhipskind.com/adamas/): Productivity toolkit for call
  center agents — hold timers, call flow guides, pattern formatters, quick
  notes, and dark/light themes.
- [Lgenia](https://lgenia.com/): Official website for a biotech company;
  built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
